bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: encodeWorkId()/encodeURIComponent() applied at every call site (api.js x3, navigate() x11)
bugs_found_and_fixed.verified_via: react-router matchPath() proof + live API calls with %2F-encoded IDs

bugs_found_and_fixed.description: RiskAnalysis.jsx assumed the old demo indicator shape {name, level, score, description}; real Phase 4 indicators use {type, message, observed_value, threshold, points} and rendered as undefined/broken
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: getIndicatorMeta() compatibility layer supporting both shapes
bugs_found_and_fixed.verified_via: live GET /risk/{id} against staging, confirmed correct rendering logic for real indicator payloads

bugs_found_and_fixed.description: react-hooks/set-state-in-effect lint error introduced by initial pagination-reset effect

Status filter is free-text (no distinct-status endpoint exists, and real vocabulary differs from old demo vocabulary)
State dropdown is a static 32-value snapshot documented in code, derived once from staging, not live-aggregated
No real browser click-through was performed in this environment; verified via build/lint, react-router matchPath proofs, and live API-contract testing instead
